aim: SIGNula — a universal all-in-one CIAM / single-sign-on identity platform (PHP 8.4, MySQLi + prepared statements, MariaDB; Dreamhost shared hosting, no Composer in prod) providing internal accounts, MFA, passwordless, OAuth account-linking, passkeys/WebAuthn, a secure JSON REST API for first- and third-party service integration, multi-tier paid subscriptions, and full activity logging + data-protection tooling.
